edu_daycare_inclusive: Are there daycare/childcare centers in your state or region where children with Down syndrome are together with children without Down syndrome?
edu_law_freepostsecondary: Is there a state law/policy enabling adults (22 years old and over) with Down syndrome to have access to a free (publicly-funded) post-secondary education (i.e., education after high school)?
edu_daycare_access: What proportion of children with Down syndrome in your state or region have access to daycare/childcare services, if desired by their parents?
edu_school_enroll: What proportion of children with Down syndrome are enrolled in school in your state or region?
edu_inclusion: In your state or region, what proportion of students with Down syndrome who are enrolled in school, <u>ages 6-13</u>, are being educated in inclusive school classrooms (i.e., educated alongside their neurotypical peers)?
edu_inclusion2: In your state or region, what proportion of students with Down syndrome who are enrolled in school, <u>ages 14-21</u>, are being educated in inclusive school classrooms (i.e., educated alongside their neurotypical peers)?
edu_curriculum_adapted: In your state or region, what proportion of students with Down syndrome who are enrolled in publicly-funded school have an adapted curriculum to meet their needs?
edu_teacher_training: In your state or region, what proportion of teachers have access to training on how best to educate students with Down syndrome?
comm_sports: Are there sports activities specifically for people with Down syndrome and for people with other intellectual disabilities in your state?
comm_sports_inclusive: Are there organizations that offer sports where people with and without disabilities play together in your state?
comm_family_learn: What proportion of family members of people with Down syndrome have opportunities to meet and learn from other family members of people with Down syndrome?
comm_neglang_people: What proportion of people in your state or region refer to people with Down syndrome using negative language (e.g., "retard," "Mongol," or "suffering from Down syndrome")?
comm_neglang_media: How much of the news media in your state or region refers to people with Down syndrome using negative language (e.g., "retard," "Mongol," or "suffering from Down syndrome")?
comm_kept: What proportion of live-born babies diagnosed with Down syndrome are kept by their families (opposed to being given up for adoption or abandoned)?
indep_transition: Are there government-financed programs to support people with Down syndrome to transition between school and work in your state?
indep_transport: Are there government-financed services to make public transportation accessible to people with intellectual disabilities?
indep_edu_relationships: For most adolescents and adults with Down syndrome, are books and educational materials on the subject of romantic and sexual relationships available in your state?
indep_govt_fin: What proportion of adults with Down syndrome are able to receive financial assistance (any amount) from the state government solely because of their disability alone?
indep_volunteer:
In your state or region, what proportion of adults with Down syndrome have a volunteer (unpaid) job* for at least 10 hours a week?
*This does not include organized day programs/daycares
indep_work_paid: In your state or region, what proportion of adults with Down syndrome have a paid job?
indep_work_minwage: In your state or region, what proportion of adults with Down syndrome who are working have jobs where they are paid at least minimum wage?
indep_work_20hr: In your state or region, out of people with Down syndrome who have a paid job, what proportion work 20 or more hours/week?
indep_work_inclusive: In your state or region, out of people with Down syndrome who have a paid job, what proportion work alongside people without disabilities?
indep_work_benefits: In your state or region, out of people with Down syndrome who have a paid job, what proportion receive the same employment benefits (not wages; e.g., insurance or retirement savings) as people without Down syndrome?
indep_livingexp: Out of adults with Down syndrome who desire to live outside of the parental home, what proportion receive financial support from the state government to cover their basic living expenses?
indep_exclude: In your state or region, what proportion of adults with Down syndrome are excluded when making decisions about their lives?
indep_accommodations: What proportion of adults with Down syndrome receive reasonable workplace accommodations from their employers in your state or region?
health_prenatal: Is prenatal screening for Down syndrome available in your state or region?
health_nipt: Is cell-free DNA noninvasive prenatal screening (NIPT/NIPS) available in your state or region?
health_exp: Do people with Down syndrome experience worse access to healthcare than the general population in your state or region?
healthy_qual: Do people with Down syndrome experience lower quality healthcare than the general population in your state or region?
health_covid_plan: Did your state government develop a plan to address access to healthcare for people with intellectual disabilities during the COVID-19 crisis in 2020?
health_covid_access: In your state or region, did people with Down syndrome who had COVID-19 experience worse access to healthcare than the general population in 2020?
health_nips_paid: In your state or region, what proportion of expectant couples have NIPT/NIPS paid for at least partially by insurance and/or state government resources?
health_speech: In your state or region, what proportion of babies with Down syndrome receive speech therapy services by <u>2 years of age</u>?
health_heart: In your state or region, what proportion of babies with Down syndrome, who need heart surgery, have access to it?
health_hearing_test: In your state or region, what proportion of people with Down syndrome have access to hearing tests?
health_hearing_treat: In your state or region, what proportion of people with Down syndrome, who need medical or surgical treatment for hearing loss (hearing aids or tympanostomy tubes), have access to it?
health_mental: In your state or region, what proportion of people with Down syndrome have access to mental health/behavioral services, if needed?
health_afford: In your state or region, what proportion of people with Down syndrome whose families cannot afford healthcare have access to free (publicly-financed) healthcare?
health_birthcontrol:
In your state or region, what proportion of women with Down syndrome have access to birth control*, if supported by the family?
*We do NOT consider forced sterilization to be a form of birth control
health_prenatal_paid:
In your state or region, what proportion of expectant couples have prenatal screening* other than NIPT/NIPS paid for at least partially by insurance and/or government resources?
*Amniocentesis, chorionic villus sampling (CVS), screening blood tests
health_terminate: In your state or region, what proportion of parents feel pressured to terminate pregnancies prenatally diagnosed with Down syndrome?
health_prenatal_info: In your state or region, what proportion of expectant parents receive prenatal information about Down syndrome from their healthcare professional that is accurate, balanced, and up-to-date?
policy_vote: In your state or region, are adults with Down syndrome allowed to vote in local, state, and national elections, regardless of whether they have a guardian?
policy_marry: In your state or region, do adults with Down syndrome have the legal right to marry, regardless of whether they have a guardian?
policy_abuse_invest: Does your state have a legal process for investigating suspected cases of physical and sexual abuse/assault for people with Down syndrome?
policy_sterilization: Are there state laws/policies in place to prevent the sterilization of people with Down syndrome against their will?
policy_adoptionunder: Are babies with Down syndrome <u>UNDER 2 years old</u> more likely to be put up for adoption in your state or region on an annual basis than the typical population?
policy_adoptionover: Are people with Down syndrome <u>OVER 2 years old</u> more likely to be put for adoption in your state or region on an annual basis than the typical population?
policy_abuse: Are people with Down syndrome physically or sexually abused/assaulted more than the general population in your state or region?
policy_openinput: Is your state government open to your organization's input into the development of government policy or services?
policy_influence: Overall, as an organization, how much influence do you feel you have with your state government?
